SUMMARY.md: Every package: each term (1, 3, 6, 12 months) for each device tier (3, 5, 10, 15 observed).
Headline packages (observed: the 3-device packages for 1, 3, 6 and 12 months).
Maximum number of devices per subscription.
Price of one additional device, as a decimal string (observed "25").

Public pricing endpoint of the Femboy VPN subscription service (`femboyvpn.connecto.lol`). Knowledge source: the community Swift client https://github.com/l0v3m0n3y/femboyvpn (src/femboyvpn.swift), with the endpoint probed live on 2026-10-23. The client also wraps account, quote, payment and operation-status calls (/auth/*, /me/*, /operations/{id}); those are POST calls or require a logged-in session cookie, so they are deliberately left out. Only GET /public/tariffs works without an account. Unverified: the meaning of `mode` and `version` beyond the observed values ("production", 1); whether `items` is always the 3-device subset of `packages` as observed; any rate limit (none documented). Prices are decimal strings in RUB as served.
